g.text: Showing code is fine - everyone can see each other's code.
Treat it as a marketing tool: show what you would want to see.
All deliverables in good shape, code is extensible,
Use the Vector2 current direction variables if that helps
If the timer doesn't work, state the features
and reference the requirements as per 6b.
